caveats: ONLINE is a stored status, not a verified current heartbeat
No device had last_seen_at within 24 hours of the observed_at value
No new activity in prior 24h in selected command tables
Numbers are historical scoped counts, not global agent census
Duration values are historical completed-success intervals; not an ETA or budget
No device ID, tokens, payload, result content or customer data included
PREPROD is only a historical environment label in a LAB database, not a revived App PREPROD
No new live connector or Supabase writes
query_provenance: information_schema.columns scoped to cerebro_device_agents_preprod, cerebro_device_commands_preprod, cerebro_device_results_preprod

SELECT count, max(last_seen_at), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at>now()-interval '24 hours') FROM public.cerebro_device_agents_preprod WHERE company_id='fenix' GROUP BY company_id,environment,status
SELECT count, count FILTER state, max(completed_at) FROM public.cerebro_device_commands_preprod WHERE company_id='fenix' GROUP BY company_id,environment,state
SELECT count and semantic_verified aggregates on LEFT JOIN public.cerebro_device_results_preprod using command_id and device_id, scoped to company_id='fenix'
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5/0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM completed_at-created_at)) FILTER state='COMPLETED' AND completed_at>=created_at, grouped by environment
